packaging.assessment: All three control runs report all 43 reactor entries as SUCCESS in the verify reactor, so modules whose tests fail still reach packaging. This is a verify lifecycle, not install. The baseline also ran clean install; the packaging phase is reached, but the full workload is not completely equal.

failing_module_example.note: ContactsControllerTest failures are visible in the control test report; the module still reaches package in the control verify reactor.

limitations: Control uses verify, not install. The baseline clean install pass also installs artifacts.
Control is single-sided; the historical baseline and rescued runs are comparison data, not rerun.
The three -T 1 attribution runs are not included.
